name: Nagi Kuurin
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c10021]Natsuki[/url]'s classmate and friend in 1999. She looks and acts cold toward men but not women.

[spoiler]She and her [url=https://vndb.org/c10023]father[/url] take care of housing [url=https://vndb.org/c10020]Tsukumo[/url] in 1999 and provide him with what he needs. It is also them who invented an identity for him in order to infiltrate the society of 1999; he will now be known as "Nagi Tsukumo" by the outside world. Kuurin's role is to be his "guardian" and she will pretend to be his non-blood-related sister.[/spoiler]

She is idolized at her high school and called "Onee-sama" by her classmates [spoiler](Tsukumo will be called "Onii-sama" because he is supposed to be her brother)[/spoiler]. She takes advantage of her notoriety to seduce girls and have sex with them.

Her personality is quite similar to what it is in the present time, although she acts more ... explosive and bitter.
She is stronger than Tsukumo in singular combat.
She makes fun of him by calling him "Saru" (monkey) and, because he is a huge siscon, calling his sister's name in his sleep.
Her favorite perfume is vanilla.

[spoiler]She was the victim of horrible events in the past - the origin of her hatred towards men - and has nightmares about these events every time she falls asleep, but doesn't really remember what she was afraid of in them when she wakes up in panic. Despite this she seems to appreciate Tsukumo, or just considers him to be better than the other men she despises.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]The trait "Sex with Others" concerns her and [url=https://vndb.org/c69871]Yurika[/url] because they sleep together. There may be other girls whom she sleeps with off-screen, but not boys.[/spoiler]
